mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE selected_department (tenant_id, id) AS ( SELECT department.tenant_id, department.id FROM organization_department department INNER JOIN oa_announcement_audience_department audience ON audience.tenant_id = department.tenant_id AND audience.department_id = department.id WHERE audience.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND audience.announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND department.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION DISTINCT SELECT child.tenant_id, child.id FROM organization_department child INNER JOIN selected_department parent ON parent.tenant_id = child.tenant_id AND parent.id = child.parent_department_id WHERE child.status = 'ACTIVE' ), candidate (actor_id) AS ( SELECT membership.actor_id FROM oa_announcement announcement INNER JOIN organization_membership membership ON membership.tenant_id = announcement.tenant_id AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE announcement.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND announcement.id = #{announcementId} AND announcement.tenant_audience = 1 UNION DISTINCT SELECT membership.actor_id FROM oa_announcement_audience_member audience INNER JOIN organization_membership membership ON membership.tenant_id = audience.tenant_id AND membership.actor_id = audience.actor_id AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE audience.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND audience.announcement_id = #{announcementId} UNION DISTINCT SELECT membership.actor_id FROM selected_department department INNER JOIN organization_membership membership ON membership.tenant_id = department.tenant_id AND membership.department_id = department.id AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT actor_id FROM candidate ORDER BY actor_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_announcement_recipient recipient INNER JOIN oa_announcement announcement ON announcement.tenant_id = recipient.tenant_id AND announcement.id = recipient.announcement_id AND announcement.status = 'PUBLISHED' INNER JOIN organization_membership membership ON membership.tenant_id = recipient.tenant_id AND membership.actor_id = recipient.actor_id AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN oa_announcement_read_receipt receipt ON receipt.tenant_id = recipient.tenant_id AND receipt.announcement_id = recipient.announcement_id AND receipt.actor_id = recipient.actor_id WHERE recipient.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND recipient.actor_id = #{actorId} AND receipt.actor_id IS NULL
